decisions.reason: Data centre interconnect on owned metro fibre fits the high-bandwidth, cloud-oriented strategy, was adopted early, and costs little to keep, so the option stays open.
Optical spectrum services run on owned fibre and match rising bandwidth demand, so the strategic value is plausible and further commitment is justified despite no recent website evidence.

A self-service number ordering portal supports real-time provisioning of the voice business at low marginal cost, though it may be folded into a broader platform, so it is kept with moderate withdrawal risk.

Carrier pre-selection is a regulatory-driven legacy service in a shrinking market, and with no signs of traction since 2018 its value is unlikely to be realized, so its resources are better redeployed to software-defined offerings.
